title: Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Operational Resilience & Cyber
description:
Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Operational Resilience & Cyber Risk

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Build resilience where it matters most across cyber, technology, and third-party risk

The Role

Capco is seeking experienced Principal Consultants in Operational Resilience and Cyber Risk to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. In this senior role, you'll lead complex client engagements across financial services and energy, advising on regulatory expectations such as PRA and DORA while driving the design and implementation of robust resilience frameworks. You'll play a key role in shaping client strategy, leading transformation programmes, and contributing to capability growth. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to enhance analysis, accelerate insight generation, and improve delivery while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

• Lead operational resilience assessments, scenario testing, and control implementation programmes, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation to strengthen resilience outcomes.

• Advise clients on regulatory readiness across PRA, DORA, and other resilience frameworks, translating regulatory expectations into practical transformation strategies and sustainable operating models.

• Oversee cyber risk, third-party risk, and vendor resilience assessments, using AI-enabled analytics where appropriate to strengthen risk identification, prioritisation, and decision-making.

• Design and implement governance models, dashboards, Important Business Services (IBS), Impact Tolerance (ITOL), and reporting frameworks, ensuring robust governance, validation, and oversight where AI-assisted tools are utilised.

• Lead cyber and technology resilience transformation initiatives, including tooling, cloud security, and control enhancements, while contributing to business development, proposition development, and capability growth.

What We're Looking For

• Extensive experience delivering operational resilience, cyber risk, and third-party risk transformation within financial services, energy, or management consulting.

• Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks including PRA, DORA, and related operational resilience standards.

• Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes, including scenario testing, IBS/ITOL calibration, control remediation, and operating model transformation.

• Experience using approved AI tools, automation, or advanced analytics to enhance resilience, risk management, and programme delivery while maintaining appropriate governance and professional judgement.

• Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.

Bonus Points For

• Experience leading enterprise-wide operational resilience or cyber transformation programmes.

• Background in cloud security, cyber tooling implementation, cyber security architecture, or AI-enabled cyber analytics.

• Experience with vendor risk management, third-party governance, supply chain resilience, and remediation strategies.

• Proven track record of mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing consulting teams.

• Experience contributing to business development, proposition development, and strategic client growth.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured leadership development.

• Help shape the future of cyber and operational resilience through innovation, automation, and technology.

• Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across financial services and energy.

title: Consultant und Fördermittelexpert:in für Unternehmensnachfolge (m/w/d)
description:
Du liest Förderrichtlinien freiwillig bis zum Ende und kannst aus komplexen Förderbedingungen verständliche Orientierung für Unternehmen machen?
Bei uns übernimmst du keinen bestehenden Fachbereich, sondern baust das Themenfeld Förderung und Finanzierung für Unternehmensnachfolge selbst auf. Gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung entwickelst du die fachliche Ausrichtung und entscheidest, welche Förder- und Finanzierungsfragen wir aufgreifen und wie daraus verlässliche Informationsangebote entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Finanz- und M&A-Expertise zusammen und bringst dein Wissen selbst in Workshops und Veranstaltungen ein.
Worum es dabei geht: Jedes Jahr stehen Zehntausende kleine und mittlere Unternehmen in Deutschland vor der Nachfolgefrage. Bleibt sie ungelöst, verschwinden Betriebe, Arbeitsplätze, Wissen und regionale Wertschöpfung. Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dieses Rückgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft zu erhalten und Betriebe mit verständlichen Informationsangeboten und praxisnahen Veranstaltungen dabei unterstützen, Unternehmensnachfolgen erfolgreich vorzubereiten und umzusetzen.
Über uns: NDF ist die auf Fördermittel spezialisierte Marke der Key Progress Makers Advisory GmbH. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Startups und innovativen Unternehmen, die neue Produkte, Technologien oder Geschäftsmodelle entwickeln und dafür passende Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten suchen. Wir helfen ihnen, Förderpotenziale zu erkennen und anspruchsvolle Vorhaben so zu strukturieren, dass aus einer Idee ein tragfähiges Projekt werden kann. Diese Erfahrung bringen wir nun in ein eigenes öffentlich gefördertes Projekt rund um das Thema Unternehmensnachfolge ein.
Rahmenbedingungen: Die Stelle umfasst 39 Stunden pro Woche. Wir arbeiten hybrid und planen durchschnittlich zwei bis drei gemeinsame Bürotage pro Woche in Berlin. Start ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt, idealerweise im September 2026.

We are seeking an experienced SAP GRC Specialist to design, implement, and operate security and access-control frameworks for complex SAP landscapes, including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, and SuccessFactors. • Deep experience operating SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM).

• Experience supporting SAP audits and remediation activities.

• Hands-on experience securing Fiori, BTP, and cloud SAP applications.

• Familiarity with SAP IDM or third-party IGA tooling.

• Working knowledge of SAP Process Control.

• Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GxP, and PCI.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP-certified Security or GRC credentials.

• Experience with SAP Cloud Identity services (IAS, IPS) and SCIM-based integrations.

• Familiarity with HANA security and analytic privileges.

• Experience with continuous controls monitoring frameworks.

title: Conducteur / Collecteur de données à Nogent-le-Rotrou, France
description:
Description de l'entreprise 
Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) est une entreprise spécialisée dans la collecte de données sur le terrain, fondée en 2017 en Europe. Nous collectons des données là où l’automatisation est impossible. Nous comptons les caractéristiques, prenons des photos, réalisons des vidéos, enregistrons des voix et scannons des zones pour vous fournir tous les détails nécessaires à une prise de décision éclairée. Nos équipes de collecte de données sur le terrain sont réparties à travers l’Europe et l’Amérique du Nord, prêtes à accepter de nouveaux défis. 
 
Objectif du projet
L'objectif du projet est de collecter des images de haute qualité de rues, de points d’intérêt clés et d’espaces publics dans tous les pays de l’UE. À l’aide de véhicules équipés de caméras amovibles à 360° et de lidars, les conducteurs captureront des images complètes des environs. Les données collectées seront stockées sur des ordinateurs de bord (disques SSD) et utilisées plus tard pour améliorer l'une des cartes en ligne les plus populaires au monde.
Les collecteurs de données suivent des itinéraires prédéfinis, en se concentrant sur les rues publiques, les zones commerciales et les points d’intérêt. Pour assurer la meilleure qualité d’image, certaines zones devront être revisitées lors de conditions météorologiques favorables.
La durée du projet varie en fonction de l’étendue des travaux requis dans chaque zone ciblé de collecte de données. En moyenne, les missions impliquent de 3 à 6 mois de travail actif.
 
Horaire de travail: engagement à temps plein dans les heures normales d’ouverture (de 8 h - à 19 h)
Le processus de recrutement pour le poste de conducteur comprend les étapes suivantes : un test de conduite sécuritaire, un entretien avec un recruteur et un processus d’intégration.

title: Senior Applied Research Scientist – Computational Geometry and Meshing
description:
Industrial simulation depends on turning product and device geometry into valid, efficient discretizations. This role will advance computational geometry, meshing, simulation-ready representations, and AI-native algorithms for NVIDIA GPU platforms.
We are looking for an applied researcher who can build methods that move design data reliably from CAD to simulation. You will develop geometry, meshing, and discretization algorithms that improve robustness, numerical accuracy, and end-to-end performance across CAE, EDA, semiconductor, and scientific-computing workflows. Join us in reinventing the geometric foundation of engineering simulation!
What you'll be doing:

• Build algorithms for computational geometry, computer-aided engineering and design interoperability, mesh generation, mesh adaptation, spatial data structures, and curved discretization.

• Investigate differentiable geometry, AI-native geometry processing, learning-based meshing and discretization, and design-to-simulation workflows for inverse design, simulation-ready digital twins, and autonomous engineering workflows.

• Explore solver- and hardware-aware geometry and discretization methods that jointly optimize mesh quality, numerical accuracy, robustness, and comprehensive simulation efficiency.

• Define benchmarks for mesh quality, geometry conversion, discretization accuracy, robustness, downstream solver impact, and end-to-end simulation performance.

• Collaborate with teams across Omniverse, OpenUSD, Warp, solver engineering, NVIDIA Research, universities, and industrial partners involved in computer-aided engineering, electronic design automation, chip manufacturing, electronics, and digital twin workflows.

What we need to see:

• PhD or equivalent experience in computer science, computational geometry, scientific computing, graphics, applied mathematics, computational mechanics, engineering, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience.

• Background in computational geometry, geometry processing, mesh generation, adaptive discretization, CAD and CAE algorithms, or simulation-ready representations with 5+ years proven experience working in computational engineering.

• C++ and Python skills, with experience building algorithms for sophisticated geometry.

• Understanding of boundary representations, topology, mesh quality, discretization error, numerical robustness, and solver requirements, supported by research, software, or industrial impact.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Experience with CAD kernels or formats such as Parasolid, ACIS, Open Cascade, CATIA, NX, Creo, SOLIDWORKS, STEP, IGES, B-Rep, NURBS, or spline-based representations.

• Experience with tetrahedral, hexahedral, polyhedral, anisotropic, adaptive, boundary-layer, curved, or high-order mesh generation.

• Work in isogeometric analysis, remeshing, meshless methods, topology optimization, shape optimization, differentiable geometry, or AI-native mesh generation.

• Experience with geometry repair, feature or simulation-intent recognition, parameterization, persistent correspondence, learning-based geometry representations, GPU spatial algorithms, or solver-aware adaptation.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 192,000 USD - 304,750 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Transport- und Auslieferungsfahrer (m/w/d/x) in Teilzeit
description:
Deine Rolle:

Für unseren Standort in Hamburg suchen wir einen Transport- und Auslieferungsfahrer oder eine Transport- und Auslieferungsfahrerin (m/w/d/x) in Teilzeit (19-20 Stunden/Woche). . Du lieferst unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen mit dem Transporter nach vorgegebener Route bis vor die Haustür unserer Kunden. Du bist hauptsächlich an den Tagen Samstag, Montag, Dienstag oder Mittwoch im Einsatz . Diese Stelle ist zunächst auf 24 Monate befristet - eine spätere Verlängerung ist aber absolut möglich!

Dein Verantwortungsbereich:

• Eigenständige Beladung und Bedienung unserer Lieferfahrzeuge 

• Sicherung der Kochboxen in dem dir zugewiesenen Transporter

• Auslieferung unserer Produkte (Lebensmittel) nach vorgegebener Route

• Einhaltung unserer Lieferzeiten und die pünktliche Zustellung unserer Kochboxen

• Führen von ordnungsgemäßen Lieferprotokollen

• Sicherstellung, dass die Kochboxen in einem ordentlichen Zustand zu unseren Kunden gelangen

• Freundliche und zuvorkommende Kommunikation mit unseren Kunden, insbesondere bei Problemen in der Zustellung 

• Benachrichtigung deines Vorgesetzten (m/w/d/x) bei Problemen mit der Lebensmittelsicherheit/-qualität, Lieferschäden, Lieferproblemen und Verzögerungen der Lieferung

• Schreiben von Fahrtenbüchern

Dein Profil:

• Führerschein der Fahrzeugklasse B mindestens erforderlich

• Erste Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Transportern wünschenswert

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1)

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im zwei Schichtbetrieb

• Du bist körperlich belastbar - unsere Kochboxen können ca. bis zu 10 kg wiegen (je nach Bestellung)

• Zuverlässigkeit und Sorgfalt im Umgang mit unseren HelloFresh Kochboxen und  dem dir zur Verfügung gestellten Equipment (Transporter, IT, etc.)

• Du bist sicherheitsbewusst und achtsam, besonders bei der Nutzung unserer Lieferfahrzeuge

• Freundliches und gepflegtes Auftreten gegenüber unserer Kunden

• Du bist fokussiert darauf, dem HelloFresh-Kunden das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu bieten

Das bieten wir Dir:

• Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz mit einem tollen Team in Hamburg

• € 14,-/Stunde Basislohn plus attraktive Bonuszahlungen - so kannst du bis zu € 16,60 pro Stunde verdienen

• Spare bis zu 70 % auf jede HelloFresh Kochbox

• Ein  umfassendes Onboarding

• Spaß bei Teamevents

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge 

 

Du bist auch hungrig nach mehr? 

Bewirb Dich jetzt mit Deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen, gerne auch ohne Lichtbild und ohne Angabe von spezifischen Merkmalen wie Nationalität oder Geschlecht. Sprachzertifikate und Unterlagen zur Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis können gerne mit eingereicht werden. 

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

title: Materials Team Lead
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.

- Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 

THE MEP & STRUCTURAL PROCUREMENT TEAM

The MEP & Structural Procurement team gets the physical equipment for gigawatt-scale AI data centers, electrical, cooling, power, and structural, delivered to site on schedule.

Examples of key problems the team is working on:

- Expediting capital equipment orders where a slipped delivery pushes a construction milestone, and renegotiating vendor commitments to recover the schedule

- Managing supplier, CM, and ODM capacity across multiple concurrent project sites so lead times and allocations don't collide

- Reconciling purchase orders against engineering drawings and specs to catch scope discrepancies before equipment ships wrong

- Running root-cause analysis on delivery misses and reporting supply status to PMs and leadership with enough rigor to drive decisions

ROLE SCOPE

- Lead the materials management team: set priorities and workload across the materials managers and coach their expediting practice until every open order has an owner and a recovery plan

- Work the hardest vendor recoveries yourself, expediting capital equipment orders with direct schedule consequences and renegotiating delivery commitments the site schedule can actually absorb

- Own the consolidated root-cause and reporting rhythm to PMs and leadership, so every delivery miss has a documented cause, a corrective action, and a credible new date

- Manage 4-5+ suppliers, CMs, and ODMs across concurrent project sites, keeping capacity, lead times, and allocations from colliding between projects

- Read engineering drawings and specs against orders yourself and catch scope discrepancies before they become field problems

- Travel to vendor sites to verify production status and push recoveries in person when the situation demands it

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- 7-10+ years in global sourcing or supply chain for capital equipment or data center infrastructure

- You've led a team of buyers or materials managers, or been its clear senior anchor, setting priorities and coaching how they expedite

- You've personally expedited capital equipment orders where the slip had direct schedule consequences, and renegotiated the vendor's delivery commitment yourself, not through a subordinate

- You've managed 4-5+ suppliers, CMs, or ODMs across concurrent project sites

- You can read engineering

title: GTM Technical Sourcing Recruiter (Contract)
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission
Kong is scaling rapidly. We are building a world-class revenue engine, and to do that, we need a GTM Sourcing Recruiter who doesn't just fill seats but identifies elite talent. Our sales organization operates on MEDDIC. We believe that rigorous qualification applies just as much to hiring as it does to selling. We are looking for a talent partner who can audit a candidate’s GTM acumen, dig into their operational and executional mechanics, and ensure they have the DNA to drive big wins and make a big impact.

The Role
As a GTM Recruiter, you will help own the hiring strategy for some of our most critical roles in the CRO org. You will act as a strategic advisor to our GTM Leaders and you won’t just be passing over resumes; you will be conducting deep-dive competency interviews to ensure every candidate we hire raises the bar.

What You Will Do

1. Strategic Sourcing & Headhunting

- Build and nurture a pipeline of top talent

- Map out competitor sales orgs and execute targeted headhunting campaigns.

- Sell the Kong vision, equity story, and product value to passive candidates who aren't actively looking.

2. Stakeholder Partnership

- Partner with GTM Leadership to define "What Good Looks Like" for each specific role, region, and function.

- Provide real-time market data to hiring managers regarding salary bands, talent density, and competitor compensation.

- Challenge hiring managers when necessary - you are the expert on talent.

3. Thorough Candidate Assessment

- Go beyond the resume: Assess candidates on their specific deal mechanics. (e.g., "Who was the Economic Buyer in your biggest win?" "What Metrics did you use to build the business case?")

- Filter out drivers from passengers, lucky sellers from strategic sellers, etc. by digging into their process, business, and achievements.

4. Operational Excellence

- Drive a rigorous interview process that balances speed with quality.

- Help Educate and Mentor other recruiters on GTM terminology, objection handling, and closing strategies.

- Track conversion metrics to optimize the funnel (e.g., Passthrough Rates)

What you will bring

- Experience: GTM Sourcing experience, with a heavy focus on B2B SaaS / Enterprise Software Sales.

- Methodology Native: You are fluent in MEDDIC / MEDDPICC. You know the difference between a Champion and a Coach, and you know how to test a candidate's grasp of these concepts.

- Scale-Up Resilient: You thrive in ambiguity. You can build a plane while flying it and adapt quickly when priorities change.

- Hunter Mentality: You don’t rely on inbound applicants. You enjoy the hunt and have a creative toolkit for finding hidden talent.

- Data-Driven: You use data to influence decisions and track your own performance.

You will also serve as the company's primary source of competitive pricing intelligence and customer segmentation analysis - translating market signals into pricing and GTM recommendations that influence how we go to market.
This role works in close alignment with the Director of Sales Operations, particularly around deal desk. You will set the pricing architecture and policies that deal desk enforces at the transaction level - a clean handoff model that requires strong collaboration and clear boundaries of ownership.
The right candidate is analytically rigorous, commercially minded, and credible with senior stakeholders across Revenue, Product, and Finance. You are comfortable operating as an individual contributor while influencing decisions that affect the entire go-to-market organization.
What You'll Own
List Pricing Architecture & Governance

Packaging Strategy

• Evaluate alternative monetization models (e.g., per-developer seat, per-application, consumption-based, enterprise license) against customer preference data and competitive norms, and make data-driven recommendations on model structure

• Collaborate with Finance to model the margin and revenue implications of packaging changes before they are implemented

Competitive Pricing Intelligence

• Build and maintain a rigorous, ongoing view of how Black Duck's primary competitors - including Snyk, Veracode, Checkmar

title: Applied Machine Learning Scientist II
description:
This hybrid role requires working in the office two days per week.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

Why this role at OpenTable?

OpenTable seats 25 million diners each month across 70 000+ restaurants and taps into more than 20 years of booking data-an ideal launchpad for an early‑career ML scientist. In our tight‑knit team, every experiment you run and every model you ship goes live quickly and at scale. You’ll start with well‑scoped projects and close mentorship, then rapidly earn the freedom to pitch and implement research ideas that deliver measurable value for diners, restaurants, and the business. We celebrate agency, speed, and relentless experimentation, balanced by disciplined prioritization rooted in ML expertise and real‑world production and business constraints. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Responsibilities

• Prototype, evaluate, and productionize machine learning systems to enhance restaurant content understanding, retrieval, matching, ranking, and recommendation.

• Build and monitor scalable data and machine learning pipelines, ensuring strong data quality and reproducibility.

• Design evaluation frameworks and experiments to define success metrics and continuously improve model quality, relevance, and product impact.

• Apply large language models (LLMs) and multimodal approaches to content tasks like extraction and classification while optimizing for performance, latency, and cost.

• Develop reusable machine learning tooling and maintain rigorous standards for code quality, deployment, and documentation.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and content teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical, scalable machine learning solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical field, with 0-3 years of relevant academic or professional experience.

• Proficiency in Python and foundational machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost).

• Hands-on experience training, tuning, evaluating, and debugging classical machine learning and deep learning models, including Transformers.

• Strong foundation in software engineering principles, algorithms, and data structures, with familiarity in large-scale data systems.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business goals into machine learning metrics and address common production issues like data drift and overfitting.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience applying machine learning to text, image, or multimodal content for retrieval, matching, ranking, or recommendation.

• Familiarity with large language model (LLM) workflows for text and image processing tasks.

• Exposure to search systems, information retrieval, embeddings, or learning-to-rank methodologies.

• Experience with human-in-the-loop machine learning systems supporting operational or editorial workflows.

• Demonstrated applied curiosity through substantial technical projects, research, open-source contributions, or internships.

Benefits and Perks

• Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

• Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

• Focus on mental health and well-being:

• Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

• Company-paid subscription to Headspace

• Annual compa

title: Brand Manager
description:
We’re VOID Interactive , the kick-ass team behind the tactical shooter game Ready or Not , which has sold over 16 million copies across all platforms. We’re a fully remote, 90+ person studio made up of seriously talented individuals from all over the world who love games and creating exceptional experiences for players.
We’re now looking for an experienced Brand Manager to join us remotely and shape how VOID and our titles are positioned in the market. You’ll lead brand strategy and campaigns across announcements, content updates, DLC, platform launches and seasonal moments. Build brand foundations for new IP from zero alongside an established tactical FPS franchise.
This role reports directly to the Marketing and Publishing Director, partnering on brand strategy across the portfolio with full ownership of defined projects. Working closely with our development, publishing, creative and community teams, you’ll make sure every campaign has a clear purpose, a strong idea and a measurable commercial goal. You’ll understand what makes each game distinctive and protect that identity across every player touchpoint.
What You’ll Do
Positioning and brand strategy

• Build positioning, messaging frameworks and brand guidelines per title, and for VOID as a label.

• Keep tone, voice and visual identity coherent across store pages, trailers, social, community and PR.

• Know what each game stands for, and hold that line when scope, feedback or deadlines push against it.
Campaigns and go-to-market

• Plan and run campaign beats end to end: announcements, content updates, DLC, platform launches and seasonal moments.

• Write briefs with one clear idea per beat, then give creative, capture and community teams the room to execute it well.

• Own the marketing calendar across titles so beats reinforce each other instead of colliding.
Commercial outcomes

• Tie every campaign to a target: wish lists, conversion, reactivation or platform acquisition.

• Read Steam and first-party data, community sentiment and creator coverage, then adjust the plan rather than the report.

• Flag gaps between ambition and resources early, and bring options when you do.
Partners and orchestration

• Act as the day-to-day alignment point between development, publishing, creative, community and external partners.

• Support platform conversations with Valve, PlayStation and Xbox, including co-marketing and featuring beats.

• Direct agencies and contractors when a campaign needs more hands than we have
What We’re Looking For

• 6+ years of experience in brand management, product marketing or publishing within the games industry.

• Games industry experience is essential, ideally on premium PC or console titles.

• A portfolio of campaigns you can walk us through clearly, explaining the strategy, individual campaign beats, execution and results.

• Confidence working with data and connecting brand activity to commercial outcomes.

• Experience working across development teams, leadership, platform partners, agencies and media.

• The ability to manage several titles and major campaign moments at the same time without losing focus or quality.

• We ask for regular overlap with EU and NA working hours to collaborate with our global team.
Bonus Points If You Have

• A strong understanding of tactical shooters, milsim or other hardcore gaming communities.

• A clear understanding of the difference between authenticity within a genre and simply adopting its aesthetic.

• Go-to-market experience across console or mobile platforms alongside PC.

• Experience working on both the developer and publisher sides of the industry.

If you’re based in Ireland and have the right to work here, this role will be offered as a full-time employee position.

🎯 Vos missions
L’analyste AQ en automatisation des tests aura comme tâche principale de concevoir et développer des scripts de test d’automatisation AQ ainsi qu’organiser et exécuter les différents tests (automatisés et manuels, unitaires, fonctionnels) qui vont permettre de valider les données, la qualité et le bon fonctionnement d'un programme. Il travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs, les analystes fonctionnels, les analystes en assurance qualité et il utilisera des outils de gestion des bugs pour effectuer le suivi et documenter les solutions trouvées.

• Effectuer la planification et les stratégies de tests à tous les niveaux (automatisés, fonctionnel, régression, acceptation, performance, stress, charge, sécurité).

• Concevoir les livrables d’assurance qualité : stratégie de tests, plan de qualité, plan de test.

• Définir les métriques en assurance qualité et développer les méthodes et activités pour les ressortir.

• Programmer et créer les scripts de test d’automatisation et les jeux de données automatisés.

• Effectuer le suivi auprès des équipes de développement pour les revues de code et l’évaluation de la qualité de la programmation.

• Exécuter des tests.

• Effectuer des activités d’assurance qualité en processus d’amélioration continue.

• Planifier les travaux de tests et donner du support à l’équipe des testeurs.

• Effectuer le transfert de connaissances vers les ressources permanentes désignées d’une façon adéquate et sérieuse et dans le respect des principes et exigences du plan de transfert de connaissances du client.

• Effectuer toutes autres activités connexes.

📝 Votre profil

• Posséder 5 années d’expérience en tant qu’analyste en assurance qualité dans le domaine des technologies de l’information, dont au moins 3 ans à développer des tests automatisés.

• Avoir participé à titre d’analyste en assurance qualité dans 2 mandats, dans un contexte d’équipes multidisciplinaires et dans lesquels sa contribution représente au moins 220 jours/personne par mandat dans lequel elle a réalisé :

• La programmation de tests automatisés à l’aide de l’outil Cypress.

• La planification et les stratégies de tests à tous les niveaux : fonctionnel, régression, acceptation, performance, stress, charge et sécurité.

• Les livrables d’assurance qualité : plan de qualité, plan de test, stratégies de tests, rapports de suivi, définition des métriques en assurance qualité.

• La création de jeux de données.

• Avoir participé à au moins 1 projet de développement de système d’inf
